workshoptitle: Build an AI Interactive Report in Oracle APEX

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Workshop overview, audience, objectives, and lab flow for the new AI Interactive Report feature.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Import the Data Model, Sample Data, and Create Base Application
tutorials.description: Load the SCM scripts, create the application shell, and verify the seeded SCM objects.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Create an Interactive Report using Natural Language
tutorials.description: Create the replenishment report page on SCM_REPLENISHMENT_V.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Explore and Configure Interactive Reports with Key Phrases
tutorials.description: Explore the refreshed report layout, filter controls, drag-and-drop columns, and key phrases for report actions. Complete Lab 5 first to enable Search with AI before using the key phrases.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Configure AI Attributes for the Interactive Report
tutorials.description: Enable Search with AI and add report-level context, then add SCM-specific AI context and reference data for report columns.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Use Search with AI
tutorials.description: Test AI search prompts, row search behavior, and chip refinement.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Use the Interactive Report Chat Assistant
tutorials.description: Use chat prompts to analyze, refine, visualize, and save report views.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Enable Dictation Support [Optional]
tutorials.description: Enable voice-to-text input for the Interactive Report search bar and Chat Assistant.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help.
